pair.title: Connect your phone
pair.step1: Put the phone on the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
pair.step2: On the phone, open Settings → Device connect → PC and choose to scan a QR code.
pair.again: Connected before? Tap this PC in Settings → Device connect → PC on the phone, no QR needed.

ask.title: Allow this phone to connect?
ask.hint: Only allow it if you just scanned the QR code with this phone. Once allowed, it can share your clipboard, send you files and show notifications on this computer.

screen.title: Phone screen
screen.hint: Show the phone in a window here and use it with your mouse and keyboard.
screen.footer: You can also start it on the phone: Settings → Device connect → PC → Screencast. Close the window to stop.
screen.asking: Asking the phone to share its screen…

apps.title: Or show one app
apps.hint: It opens in its own window, and the phone stays free to use.
apps.waiting: Waiting for the phone's app list…

files.title: Files
files.hint: Drop files or folders anywhere on this window to send them. Files shared from the phone are saved in Downloads/Olink.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pc_name_hint: What your phone calls this computer: in OPPO Share and in Settings → Device connect. Leave it empty to use the computer's name. The phone picks up a new name when it next connects.

theme.system: Match my desktop · Midnight when it's dark, Classic when it's light

scroll.label: Touchpad and mouse wheel
scroll.swipe: Swipe · scrolls like a finger (works in every app)

notify.label: Notifications and clipboard
notify.desktop: Show phone notifications as desktop pop-ups
notify.clip: Share the clipboard with the phone (passwords from password managers are never sent)

background.label: Running in the background
background.login: Start Olink in the tray when I log in
background.hint: Closing this window keeps Olink running in the tray, so your phone can still connect. Quit it from the tray icon.

settings.saved: Changes are saved right away. Screen quality applies the next time you show the phone screen.

drop.title: Drop to send to your phone
drop.sub: The phone asks you to accept.

transfer.waiting: Waiting for you to accept on the phone · {{size}}
transfer.not_sent: Not sent: cancelled, declined on the phone, or the connection dropped

demo.need_app: Open this inside the app to use the phone.

status.already_running: Olink is already running; showing it.

error.ports_busy: Another program is using Olink's network ports, so it can't reach your phone. Close it, then start Olink again.
error.not_background: Olink isn't running in the background.
error.pc_name_len: the PC name can be at most {{max}} characters
error.pc_name_chars: the PC name can't contain line breaks or control characters
error.too_big: {{name}} is 4 GB or larger, which can't be sent yet.
error.too_many: The folder has more than {{max}} items.
